title: UAP Bacolod Azucar marks 7th anniversary
excerpt: The United Architects of the Philippines (UAP) Bacolod Azucar Chapter recently marked its 7th anniversary with a celebration that gathered chapter members and past leaders, among others, for a night of gratitude and fellowship.
content:
The United Architects of the Philippines (UAP) Bacolod Azucar Chapter recently marked its 7th anniversary with a celebration that gathered chapter members and past leaders, among others, for a night of gratitude and fellowship.

The chapter, which was chartered on September 3, 2019, also paid tribute to its past presidents during the event.

President Demie Verde said that every year adds a new story to the Azucar journey, from professional activities and learning opportunities to community involvement, fellowship, and chapter initiatives.

These stories are being shaped by the leaders and members, who willingly share their time, talents, experiences, and passion, Verde said, adding that this does not only strengthen the chapter, but also contribute to the larger UAP community.

The anniversary theme, “Seven Years. Seven Stories,” celebrates these experiences while looking toward what lies ahead.

“Building Legacy and Designing Tomorrow” reflects the chapter’s continuing commitment to build upon what has been accomplished while creating new opportunities for growth, collaboration, and meaningful impact. ||
